    AI Overview
    Yes, Hannah Montana is "coming back" for a special 20th Anniversary event on Disney+ premiering March 24, 2026, featuring Miley Cyrus reuniting with cast members and revisiting iconic sets for interviews, not a new scripted series, but a celebration of the show's legacy.
     
    What to Expect:
    • The Special:
      A Disney+ special titled Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special, where Miley Cyrus reflects on the show with host Alex Cooper (Call Her Daddy). 
    • Reunion on Set:
      Miley and her dad, Billy Ray Cyrus (who played her dad on the show), return to recreated sets, including the Stewart family living room and Hannah's closet. 
    • Iconic Looks:
      Miley has been seen back in the signature blonde wig and pop star persona. 
    • Content Marathon:
      Disney+ is also streaming all seasons and movies of Hannah Montana leading up to the special. 
    Key Details:
    • Premiere Date: March 24, 2026, exactly 20 years after the original show premiered. 
    • Platform: Disney+. 
    • Format: A retrospective, not a new scripted episode or full series, though fans hope for performances.

      AI Overview
      Yes, Hannah Montana is "coming back" in 2026, but not as a new series; rather, Miley Cyrus is starring in The Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special, premiering on Disney+ on March 24, 2026, featuring an interview with Alex Cooper, archival footage, and revisiting iconic sets, marking two decades since the original show's debut. 
      What to Expect:
      • Format: A special hosted by podcaster Alex Cooper, with Miley Cyrus looking back at the show, filmed in front of a live studio audience. 
      • Content: An in-depth interview with Cyrus, never-before-seen archival footage, and recreations of famous sets like the Stewart living room and Hannah's closet. 
      • Date: March 24, 2026, exactly 20 years after the original series premiere. 
      • Platform: Disney+. 
      Miley's Statement:
      Miley Cyrus expressed gratitude for the show's lasting impact, stating, "'Hannah Montana will always be a part of who I am... This 'Hannahversary' is my way of celebrating and thanking the fans who've stood by me for 20 years.'".
